revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the site coordinator framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The commercial owner described the rule as a gate, not a smooth surcharge. Crossing a named business line changes eligibility for the allowance, desk, setup, waiver, or fee; staying on the other side does not. The equipment plan now has to pass through the shared skilled-operator desk. Every hour of equipment use consumes the corresponding operator-hours from the common `shared_labor_hours` pool through `labor_coeff[e]`. Equipment B2 is still available, but using it at all brings the one-time opening fee `b2_activation_fee`, so its benefit has to justify opening that line. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
